text: You're tossing your keys up to Dave, on the second floor.
In seven seconds, gravity doubles. Everywhere on Earth.
Your keys stop short… and drop twice as fast.
You suddenly weigh double. So does everyone.
Each step feels like carrying a second you.
Only the balloon wins. It rises even faster.
Every plane in the sky starts to sink.
In five seconds, this one drops 120 meters.
Every bridge and tower holds twice its weight.
Your heart pushes blood that weighs double.
And the space station? It just fell a football field.
